note: The whole way of a spoken order to silence the alarm, from the panel to the server, for every confirmation mode (voice.silence_confirmation). ARMOR-VOICE-AI plays each path against its own turn service and ARMOR-SERVER checks the subject it gives the voice service, so the two ends cannot drift apart. A path says what the person says, what the server answers the first time it is asked, and what the voice service must ask next.

paths.name: off: the order goes straight to the server
double turn: the person says yes and the token of the server is echoed back
double turn without a panel: the subject is the operator
pin: the PIN is proved on the panel and never travels, the service vouches for it
challenge: the number shown on the screen is said and the service vouches for it
